definitions.explanation: The state of working too much or too hard. Formed from {働|はたら}く (to work) plus the suffix 〜{過|す}ぎ (excess, too much).

examples.japanese: {働|はたら}き{過|す}ぎは{体|からだ}に{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: Overwork is bad for your health.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}、{働|はたら}き{過|す}ぎで{疲|つか}れている。
examples.english: Lately I'm tired from working too much.

examples.japanese: {働|はたら}き{過|す}ぎが{原因|げんいん}で{倒|たお}れる{人|ひと}もいる。
examples.english: Some people collapse because of overwork.

notes:
Composed of {働|はたら}く (to work) plus the suffix 〜{過|す}ぎ, which attaches to verb stems to mean 'doing too much'.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {働|はたら}き{過|す}ぎで{倒|たお}れる: to collapse from overwork
- {働|はたら}き{過|す}ぎを{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent overwork

RELATED WORDS:
- {過労|かろう}: overwork — more clinical and formal, as in {過労死|かろうし} (death from overwork)
- {食|た}べ{過|す}ぎ: overeating — the same 〜{過|す}ぎ pattern
